issue_description.description: The audit found no concrete defect in the requested partition or its immediate integration boundaries. The static build generated seven HTML routes and seven page-specific Markdown siblings. Each HTML document advertised exactly one existing Markdown sibling. The focused browser suite confirmed Markdown responses as text/markdown, homepage JSON-LD identities, precise llms.txt guidance, discovery membership, and the explicit 404 recovery artefact. The documented inability of GitHub Pages to perform same-URL Accept negotiation or emit request-dependent Vary: Accept is a hosting capability limit, not a defect in this static sibling-route implementation.
issue_description.expected_vs_actual: | Aspect | Expected | Actual | |--------|----------|--------| | **Static routes** | Seven HTML routes advertise seven prerendered Markdown siblings | Seven one-to-one HTML-to-Markdown mappings were generated and verified | | **Agent identity** | Homepage publishes Organization, WebSite, and SoftwareApplication JSON-LD | One valid JSON-LD graph contains all three linked entities and the available contact and city-level address facts | | **Discovery guidance** | llms.txt states specific best-fit use cases and direct Markdown links | The generated document follows the expected heading and link structure and names product discovery, checkout, order support, retailer fit, and direct Markdown URLs | | **Hosting boundary** | Static siblings are used without claiming same-URL Accept negotiation | README and source comments state the GitHub Pages limitation and make no unsupported negotiation claim |
